picks.name: FJAAK
picks.source_note: New artist discovery: self-released. Similar raw, analogue techno territory to your Answer Code Request and Phase Fatale picks.
picks.bio: Berlin duo known for raw, analogue-driven techno. "015" (September 17, 2026) is a four-track EP -- Serotonin, Threshold, Bio Data, Wax Pack -- with lead single "Serotonin" previewed ahead of the full release.
picks.why_listen: Straight-up, hardware-driven Berlin techno with real grit -- solid peak-time material for a driving stretch of a set.

picks.name: Alex Nut Presents Sum Of Its Parts
picks.source_note: New release on Eglo Records from a label you already follow.
picks.bio: Alex Nut's new collaborative project, drawing on a rotating cast of UK musicians (Sam Crowe of Lianne La Havas, Junior Ali-Balogun of Sault/Cleo Sol, Duane Atherley of Kokoroko). "The Message EP" (June 5, 2026) pairs a 10-minute spiritual jazz original with a Boddhi Satva Ancestral Soul remix that resets it into slowed, dubbed broken beat.
picks.why_listen: A deep, musician-led spiritual jazz/broken-beat crossover from a label you already trust -- the Boddhi Satva remix in particular is DJ-friendly.
